definitionZh: 滚动时轴 CSS 属性用于指定滚动条方向,用于提供滚动驱动动画的时长,通过滚动可滚动元素(croller)推进.
sourceDefinition: The scroll-timeline-axis CSS property is used to specify the scrollbar direction that will be used to provide the timeline for a scroll driven animation, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller).
